# telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_resend_verification (Action)

Sends a new verification code to a phone number whose WhatsApp registration was started with telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number. Submit the code with the telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_verify action.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `phone_number` (String) The phone number.

### Optional

- `verification_method` (String) How the verification code is delivered, sms or voice. Defaults to sms. One of `sms`, `voice`.
